title: The Dread King
altNames: Sovereign of the Ashen Crown, The Nightbound Regent
subheader: Undying monarch whose court rules from the Obsidian Sepulcher
description:
## Overview

The Dread King is the legendary ruler of a deathless court said to reign beneath the Blackglass Range. Chroniclers describe his dominion as neither living nor dead, a realm of suspended dusk where vows are weighed in silence and the sun is only a memory.

## Origins and Ascension

Ballads from the border cantons claim the Dread King was once a mortal warlord who forged a crown from the meteorite iron that fell during the Ashen Comet. The crown bound his spirit to the land, transforming his throne into an anchor that outlasted siege, famine, and time itself.

## Court of the Sepulcher

His retainers are called the **Nightbound**, oath-sworn nobles whose names have been erased from surface records. They ride pale steeds through vault corridors of polished obsidian, carrying lanterns that reveal hidden contracts etched into the stone. Petitioners must present three truths and one secret before the court, lest the monarch's scribes seal their voices for a year and a day.

## Omens and Influence

Travellers report that crows gather in perfect circles when the Dread King's heralds are abroad, and that iron tools grow cold to the touch near the Sepulcher. Villages that trade with his emissaries receive protection from raiders but must leave a share of their harvest at boundary shrines each new moon.

## Legends of the Crown

The Ashen Crown is said to grant prophecy at the cost of memory. Some tales insist the Dread King does not remember his own face, only the grief that forged his reign. Others suggest he preserves the names of every fallen soldier, holding them in stasis until the last war is settled.
